source_text: Design a compact desktop storage box with a reusable latch. The box should open and close repeatedly without accidental opening during normal handling. The latch should be easy for a user to operate while remaining secure during transport. The product should be suitable for low-cost manufacturing and should be practical for desktop use. The design should be mechanically plausible and easy to assemble.
product_intent: A compact desktop storage box with a reusable latch mechanism that enables repeated opening and closing operations while maintaining security during transport and normal handling.
user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop storage box with a reusable latch that can open and close repeatedly without accidental opening during normal handling, is easy for a user to operate while remaining secure during transport, suitable for low-cost manufacturing, and practical for desktop use.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop storage box with a reusable latch.
The box should open and close repeatedly without accidental opening during normal handling.
The latch should be easy for a user to operate while remaining secure during transport.
The product should be suitable for low-cost manufacturing and should be practical for desktop use.
The design should be mechanically plausible and easy to assemble.
One-handed operation is desirable but not mandatory.
Repeated opening and closing is expected.
A separate metal fastener is allowed but not required.

requirements.statement: The product must provide a mechanism for repeatedly opening and closing the storage box.
The product must remain securely closed during normal handling and transport without accidental opening.
The product must have a latch that is easy for a user to operate.
The product must maintain secure closure during transport.
The product must be suitable for low-cost manufacturing.

verification.reason: Cost cannot be verified without manufacturing specifications

requirements.statement: The product must be practical for desktop use.
The product must be mechanically plausible and easy to assemble.

verification.observable: mechanical plausibility and ease of assembly

requirements.statement: The product must have a reusable latch mechanism.

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Desktop Use
operating_scenarios.description: A user opens and closes the box repeatedly for storage purposes while using it on a desktop.

operating_scenarios.name: Transport Conditions
operating_scenarios.description: The box is moved and handled during transport while maintaining secure closure.

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing and Assembly
operating_scenarios.description: The box is manufactured and assembled using low-cost methods.

assumptions.statement: The box will be used primarily in a desktop environment with typical handling conditions.
The user will be able to operate the latch with reasonable force and dexterity.

unknowns.reason: The request states that the box should open and close repeatedly but does not specify how many times or what level of durability is required.

relations.rationale: Secure closure depends on having a reusable latch mechanism
Secure transport depends on having a reusable latch mechanism
